name: heavypad disk space warning
description: HeavyPad root disk also backs the orchestration Postgres local-path volume. Warn below 15% or 100 GiB available, or below 10% free inodes; critical conditions are handled by the critical rule.
query:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'disk_paths' AS disk_paths,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_bytes' AS BIGINT) AS free_bytes,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_ratio' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS free_ratio,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_inode_ratio' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS free_inode_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attributes->>'disk_paths' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC) AS sample_rank
  FROM records
  WHERE service_name = 'bandwidth-watchdog'
    AND attributes->>'watchdog_event' = 'disk.sample'
    AND attributes->>'host' = 'heavypad'
    AND start_timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
), latest AS (SELECT * FROM samples WHERE sample_rank = 1)
SELECT 'HeavyPad root/Postgres disk space warning' AS message, start_timestamp, disk_paths, free_bytes, free_ratio, free_inode_ratio FROM latest WHERE (free_ratio < 0.15 OR free_bytes < 107374182400 OR free_inode_ratio < 0.10) AND NOT (free_ratio < 0.05 OR free_bytes < 32212254720 OR free_inode_ratio < 0.02)
